rv.q: If you’re into the smutty vibe, Ancient Grease is a right laugh.
Ancient Grease has something they occasionally lack: pure, shameless fun.
The Vault’s production of Ancient Grease won me over, and had me bopping, whooping, and chortling.
The problem? It’s just not very funny.
Ancient Grease is the word, and it has most certainly got groove and meaning.

cn.t: This cheeky Grease parody set in Ancient Greece divides critics with its ribald humor and camp sensibility. Fans of outrageous comedy embrace its fun premise, while others find the concept doesn't fully deliver.
